proof_scope: Cholesky compression plus a rounded exact multinomial energy type; independent derivations in leaves 01 and 02. N62 is a supplied candidate manuscript and is not externally validated.

claim: For compact G, [U_g,H]=0, E_g=U_gEU_g*, normalized Haar measure, and a shared nuisance g across n uses, inf_{rho=P rho P} sup_g Tr(rho E_g^tensor n)=lambda_min(P Omega_n P), Omega_n=integral E_g^tensor n dg. Restricting the optimization to separable states gives the same equality with the minimum over legal separable states.
proof_scope: The worst risk dominates its Haar average; twirling an average-minimizer preserves the hard support and makes its risk constant. Collective local twirling preserves separability.
supplied_inputs: H and compact energy-commuting unitary nuisance representation
parallel probe and exact hard support
strongest_baseline: The same fully informed or robustly optimized separable probe class under the same nuisance and hard support.
falsifier: A legal probe/nuisance family violating the Haar-minimax equality under compactness and the stated covariance assumptions.
unresolved_gate: External proof/priority audit and extensions beyond a common compact symmetry group.

falsifier: An explicit legal two-use state with worst-phase miss below 1/4; the exact averaged-block eigenvalue rules this out under the specified interface.
unresolved_gate: External verification and priority search; actual calibration/noise model and larger-use robust exponent.
